newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 6,464 to dollar for Feb 12 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 6,464 to dollar for Feb 12 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 6,464 to the dollar for February 12.
The reference rate set on Monday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Friday for February 11 is 6,376 to the dollar. It was 6,183 on Monday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
